# PowerPlay v1.2.1 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Fixed a D-pad focus/scrolling interaction that could make floating library headers collapse or bounce.
- Adopted the targeted upstream focus fix without replacing PowerPlay's other performance optimizations.
